draft.title: Cooling by evaporation
card: Particles in a liquid move at different speeds. Some have more kinetic energy than others, and the average sets the temperature.
Evaporation happens at the surface. A particle can escape as a gas only if it has enough kinetic energy to break free of the attraction of its neighbours.
So the fastest particles leave first. The particles left behind have a lower average kinetic energy.
Lower average kinetic energy means the remaining liquid is cooler. This is why sweat on skin cools the body as it evaporates.
draft.remember: Evaporation removes the most energetic particles, so the liquid left behind cools.

a.q: Why does a liquid cool as it evaporates?
opts: The fastest particles leave, so the average energy falls
Every particle slows down by the same amount as it escapes
The liquid gains energy from the air and so it cools
Particles that escape take the slowest ones with them
a.why: Only particles with enough kinetic energy can escape, so the fastest ones leave. The average kinetic energy of the particles left behind falls, and so does the temperature. It is not the slowest particles that leave, because they cannot break free.
a.clue: Think about which particles can break free of their neighbours.

b.q: Mia steps out of a pool on a warm, dry day in Mildura and feels cold as the water on her skin dries. What is the best explanation?
opts: The fastest water particles escape and take energy with them
The water on her skin gains energy from the cool pool
The slowest water particles escape and leave the warmer ones
Her skin loses all of its particles as the water dries
b.why: The most energetic water particles leave the surface, so the average energy of the water left on her skin falls and it cools her skin. The slowest particles do not have enough energy to escape, so the idea that they leave is wrong.
b.clue: Which particles have enough energy to leave the surface?

a.best: The fastest particles leave, so the average energy falls

b.best: The fastest water particles escape and take energy with them
